  PROBLEM: The new `|| unblock_log "item=${ITEM} fixup=${wait_fixup} op=fixup_delivered outcome=warn reason=wait_update_failed"` line adds the outcome `warn` and the reason `wait_update_failed`. The log-format header at line 118 (`UNBLOCK_JUDGE item= kind= stop= fixup= op=fixup_delivered outcome=closed|resume|skip reason=|pr=`), agents.d/8530-unblock-fixup-delivered-close.md:5 and changelog.d/8530-unblock-fixup-delivered-close.md:16 do not document either value. The line also drops the `kind=` and `stop=` fields that every other `op=fixup_delivered` line carries through `log_head`.
  WHY: When the wait-comment PATCH (`unblock_patch_comment`, lines 687-691) fails after a successful close, the run emits a line the contract does not describe. Log consumers, dashboards and greps keyed on the documented schema will miss or misclassify it, and this line is the only trace of an item that is closed while its wait comment is not marked `done`. All reviewers rated it NIT; no severity disagreement.
- agents.d/8530-unblock-fixup-delivered-close.md:5 (Stable log prefixes contractual section) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The contract registry for `UNBLOCK_JUDGE` log prefixes lists only `outcome=closed|resume|skip` and leaves out the new `outcome=warn` emission in `scripts/unblock_judge.sh`.
  WHY: Log consumers and dashboard filters set up to match the documented contract will ignore this log line or report it as malformed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1841 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No test in tests/test_unblock_judge.py exercises the new error path, where `unblock_patch_comment` fails after a successful close and the run emits `outcome=warn reason=wait_update_failed`. `test_fixup_delivered_close_failure_keeps_the_wait_and_posts_the_marker_once` (line 5190) fails the close PATCH before the wait update, so it never reaches this branch.
  WHY: A regression on this path would pass CI unnoticed, because no test asserts that the warn line is present.

  PROBLEM: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1841 `|| unblock_log "item=${ITEM} fixup=${wait_fixup} op=fixup_delivered outcome=warn reason=wait_update_failed"` adds a fourth outcome, `warn`, with `reason=wait_update_failed`. The header at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:118, the agents.d contractual bullet and the changelog fragment list only `closed|resume|skip`, and none mentions `reason=wait_update_failed`. The line also drops the `kind=`/`stop=` fields that the other `op=fixup_delivered` lines carry through `log_head`.
  WHY: If the close succeeds but the wait-comment PATCH fails (`unblock_patch_comment`, lines 687-691), the line is emitted in an undocumented shape. Greps built on the registered outcomes will miss or misclassify the only trace of an item that is closed while its wait comment is not marked `done`. Suggested fix: add `|warn` and `reason=wait_update_failed` to line 118 and to both fragments, and add `kind=${ITEM_KIND} stop=${ITEM_STOP}` to line 1841.
